'''July 2001 Virginia Beach tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Virginia Beach, VA on 8 July 2001. It is known from Mark Carila's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2597">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-08-virginia-beach-va-7-8-01-yavin-ivd2597/ virginia-beach-va-7-8-01-yavin-iv], DeckTech (Mark "MASSACRE" Carila, 8 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-08-virginia-beach-va-7-8-01-yavin-ivd2597/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 8 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Virginia Beach, VA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
